title: FedEval-LLM: Federated Evaluation of Large Language Models on Downstream Tasks with Collective Wisdom

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating order consistency by presenting question-answer pairs to LLM referees in both possible sequential orders and discarding inconsistent judgments to address order preferences (positional bias).

Using a collective majority voting strategy among a group of multiple personalized LLM referees to mitigate the subjective biases and uncertainties associated with relying on a single evaluation model.
